hero.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original 16:9 editorial cover for a rigorous, accessible review of photonic quantum sampling and the starting distributions of generative molecular models. Primary request: make the relationship DIFFERENT STARTING STATISTICS, SAME KIND OF GENERATIVE TRANSFORMATION, DIFFERENT CANDIDATE STRUCTURES legible as an elegant conceptual scene. Create a refined flat screen-print and gouache editorial illustration on warm pale ivory, restrained cobalt-blue, vermilion, amber and charcoal inks, with generous negative space and subtle ink texture. Two parallel horizontal compositions stacked with clear breathing room: at the upper left, a compact motif of overlapping light fringes gathers into an irregular structured cluster of small dots; at the lower left, a softer smooth cloud of dots has visibly different organization. In the center of each row, the same stylized abstract folding mechanism, like an identical broad curved strip of paper passing through a simple bend, transforms the dots into a small group of distinct folded ribbon candidates on the right. The two folding mechanisms have the same shape and scale. Both rows produce visually interesting, equally plausible candidates; do not portray one row as a winner, larger yield, failure or proven better quality. The folded ribbons should suggest generated molecular or protein-shape candidates without drawing literal atoms, chemical bonds or a real known protein. The upper light-fringe motif should make optical interference recognizable, while the rest stays graphic and quiet. Readable at small thumbnail size, crisp deliberate silhouettes, strong rhythmic arrangement and visual hierarchy, sophisticated science-magazine composition. It is an independent conceptual metaphor, not an apparatus diagram, measured probability plot, real chemical structure, quantitative benchmark or claim that photons physically assemble molecules. No words, letters, numbers, equations, labels, arrows, logos, watermarks, people, robots, brains, circuit-board patterns, shiny metal balls, deep-space background, neon haze, glass architecture, perspective corridor or imitation of any named artist or publication's specific illustration. Exact wide 16:9 composition.
hero.claim: Two sample patterns pass through the same kind of abstract transformation and yield different ribbon candidates. No output is marked superior. Fringes, dots, folds and counts are illustrative, not a real apparatus, computed distribution or protein structure.
